decisions.quote:
The claim selected for the original study yielded a negative regression interaction term in the focal test, corresponding to an increased local degree proportion reducing the effect of holding a four-year degree on the use of verbal skills. The replication yielded a positive regression interaction term in the focal test, corresponding to an effect in a different pattern compared to the original study.

Deviations from preregistration.
There were no deviations from the preregistration plan, or changes to the preregistered script (except to remove the line limiting analysis to a random 5% subset of the data).
decisions.location: Replication Result / Deviations from preregistration, lines 852-860
decisions.reason: The report conducts only a single preregistered reproduction attempt (Model 1) reconstructing the original analysis from the paper's description and raw data sources, which fails to recover the original negative interaction coefficient (coded on Axis 1 as 'computational issues'). The differences in sample restriction, occupation matching, and CFA construction are documented as unavoidable reconstruction deviations due to omitted details in the original paper and code rather than alternative specifications or sensitivity analyses tested by the reproducer. Because no robustness checks or alternative specifications were conducted, outcome_robustness is 'not checked'.
